what: CARNAC OS is a dual-timbral wavetable synth drawing inspiration from neolithic monuments and forgotten rituals. Designed for deep sound design exploration and immediate control, it combines a MAQ 16/3-style sequencer for intricate modulated sequences with a chord sequencer for harmonic progressions. Waves are installed via a seperate installer so it's best to install from here: https://owenkirby.github.io/carnac-os/install/
author: OrbVorgis
